title: MetricSemBench: reproducibility package (PVLDB EA&B submission)
description: Frozen benchmark splits, generator, evaluator, stored per-item predictions, and a one-command script that regenerates the TPC-DS SF=1 warehouse and every table of the MetricSemBench paper without a paid call.
notes: Code: MIT. TPC-DS-derived data and stored predictions: CC BY 4.0. BIRD/Spider 2.0 material keeps its upstream licenses.
